prompt:
Create a mobile-first landing page for gig workers looking for fast business funding. The audience includes Uber drivers, delivery drivers, freelancers, independent contractors, and self-employed workers.
Visual style: bold fintech funnel with dark background, high-contrast CTA buttons, mobile app-inspired cards, trust badges, and simple step-by-step flow.
Strong hook: “Funding for Hustlers Who Don’t Fit in a Banker’s Spreadsheet.”
Hero message: “If you earn through apps, contracts, clients, or side hustles, you may still have funding options—even without a traditional business setup.”
CTA: “Check My Options”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- Who this is for
- 3-step process
- Funding use cases
- Requirements checklist
- Common reasons gig workers get denied elsewhere
- Simple application CTA
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static site files.
